# Temple Scroll Column 60 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 60 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**60:1** So that innocent blood may not be shed in the midst of the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and blood-guilt rest upon you.

**60:2** But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him and attacks him and strikes him fatally so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,

**60:3** then the elders of his city shall send and take him from there and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, and he shall die.

**60:4** Your eye shall show him no pity; you shall purge the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, so that it may go well with you.

**60:5** You shall not move your neighbor's boundary marker, which the ancestors set, in the inheritance that you will inherit in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

**60:6** A single witness shall not prevail against a person for any crime or any offense; only on the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses shall a charge be established.

**60:7** If a malicious witness rises against a person to accuse him of wrongdoing,

**60:8** then both parties to the dispute shall appear before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who are in office in those days.

**60:9** The judges shall make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a false witness who has given false testimony against his brother,

**60:10** then you shall do to him as he intended to do to his brother; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.

**60:11** The rest of the people will hear and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.

**60:12** Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

**60:13** When you go out to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots, an army greater than yours, do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.

**60:14** When you are about to engage in battle, the priest shall come forward and address the troops.

**60:15** He shall say to them: Hear, O Israel! Today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not lose heart; do not be afraid; do not panic; do not be terrified before them.

**60:16** For the LORD your God is the one who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to give you victory.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 60 reworks Deuteronomy 19:10-20:4. "Avenger of blood" for go'el ha-dam — the standard rendering. The false witness law (60:7-11) includes the lex talionis in its judicial context. The four-fold exhortation against fear (60:15) uses graduated intensity: "lose heart... afraid... panic... terrified." The war-priest's speech transitions the scroll from judicial to military legislation.*
